g.text: BUCK1 and BUCK3 outputs, to their links

g.desc: BUCK1 and BUCK3 outputs, to their links

g.text: 1. Function: Rockchip RK809-5 (BOM v1 line 2): BUCK1 vdd_logic, BUCK2 vdd_gpu, BUCK3 vcc_ddr,

g.desc: 1. Function: Rockchip RK809-5 (BOM v1 line 2): BUCK1 vdd_logic, BUCK2 vdd_gpu, BUCK3 vcc_ddr,

g.text: BUCK4 vdd_npu, BUCK5 vcc_1v8; LDO1-9 and SWOUT2 per power tree §3. VCC1-4 from VSYS_LV,

g.desc: BUCK4 vdd_npu, BUCK5 vcc_1v8; LDO1-9 and SWOUT2 per power tree §3. VCC1-4 from VSYS_LV,

g.text: VCC5-9 from vcc3v3_sys (ROCK 3C v1.4). SWOUT1 and EXT_EN unused. I2C0 at 0x20.

g.desc: VCC5-9 from vcc3v3_sys (ROCK 3C v1.4). SWOUT1 and EXT_EN unused. I2C0 at 0x20.

g.text: 2. Absent state: not applicable (never omitted). OTP defaults of the -5 part UNVERIFIED.

g.desc: 2. Absent state: not applicable (never omitted). OTP defaults of the -5 part UNVERIFIED.

g.text: 3. FB1 senses vdd_logic and FB3 the 47k / 120k divider on vcc_ddr, both on the load side of

g.desc: 3. FB1 senses vdd_logic and FB3 the 47k / 120k divider on vcc_ddr, both on the load side of

g.text: their links (blk.soc-power, blk.lpddr4x); BUCK2, 4, 5 sense their outputs.

g.desc: their links (blk.soc-power, blk.lpddr4x); BUCK2, 4, 5 sense their outputs.

g.text: 4. L: Murata DFE252012F-R47M 0.47 µH (BOM v1 line 5). Output capacitors 10 + 22 µF (HDG

g.desc: 4. L: Murata DFE252012F-R47M 0.47 µH (BOM v1 line 5). Output capacitors 10 + 22 µF (HDG

g.text: near the source); BUCK3 22 µF (Fig. 1-1). Fig. 1-1's 33 µF is met as 10 + 22 µF.

g.desc: near the source); BUCK3 22 µF (Fig. 1-1). Fig. 1-1's 33 µF is met as 10 + 22 µF.

g.text: 5. VDC: 100k / 22k from VSYS_LV with 100 nF as Fig. 1-1 from VCC_SYS: 0.69 V > 0.55 V, so

g.desc: 5. VDC: 100k / 22k from VSYS_LV with 100 nF as Fig. 1-1 from VCC_SYS: 0.69 V > 0.55 V, so

g.text: the PMIC starts when VSYS_LV first rises (bring-up confirms).

g.desc: the PMIC starts when VSYS_LV first rises (bring-up confirms).

g.text: 6. Codec unused: MCLK, BCLK, LRCLK, SDI, HP_SNS to GND; outputs and MIC1 open (BOM line 2,

g.desc: 6. Codec unused: MCLK, BCLK, LRCLK, SDI, HP_SNS to GND; outputs and MIC1 open (BOM line 2,

g.text: HDG p. 73). PDMCLK is an output (DS p. 14): left open, not grounded as line 2 lists it.

g.desc: HDG p. 73). PDMCLK is an output (DS p. 14): left open, not grounded as line 2 lists it.

g.text: 7. Open: BATDIV and SNSP/SNSN (joined, Fig. 1-1) on test pads until the ROCK 3C sheet 28

g.desc: 7. Open: BATDIV and SNSP/SNSN (joined, Fig. 1-1) on test pads until the ROCK 3C sheet 28

g.text: wiring is read (UNVERIFIED); 32.768 kHz load capacitors (22 pF optional in Fig. 1-1) not

g.desc: wiring is read (UNVERIFIED); 32.768 kHz load capacitors (22 pF optional in Fig. 1-1) not

g.text: fitted with the 7 pF SC-32S (UNVERIFIED); PWRON_N to blk.buttons and blk.maskrom.

g.desc: fitted with the 7 pF SC-32S (UNVERIFIED); PWRON_N to blk.buttons and blk.maskrom.

g.text: 8. Groups follow RK809 DS Fig. 1-1 and power tree §3 (BOM v1 line 5); LDO outputs 1 µF each.

g.desc: 8. Groups follow RK809 DS Fig. 1-1 and power tree §3 (BOM v1 line 5); LDO outputs 1 µF each.

g.text: Constraints: PCB-P-07, PCB-P-08 (PMIC_BUCKn_SW). Unless noted: resistors 1 % 0402.

g.desc: Constraints: PCB-P-07, PCB-P-08 (PMIC_BUCKn_SW). Unless noted: resistors 1 % 0402.
